original_test_intent: Execute the approved composite PCIe qualification suite for each GPU-connected bus and prove speed transitions, DMA integrity/performance, GPU power-state recovery and every other declared phase meet their individual criteria.
original_method: Pin suite build/config and enumerate its exact phase manifest; map GPU/link/topology; review each phase's targets, mutations, buffers, load, acceptance and recovery; preserve baseline logs/link/AER/driver/I/O; obtain phase-specific approval; run phases separately with stop boundaries; retain per-phase evidence; restore states and verify health.
manual_activity: PCIe/GPU owner reviews every suite phase and authorizes targets and maintenance window; operator owns I/O isolation and recovery.
required_inputs: Signed NVQual suite/version/config and complete phase manifest
Per-phase parameters, buffers/targets and acceptance thresholds
Phase-specific abort, rollback and OOB recovery
safety_requirements: Do not run an opaque all-in-one suite
Prove DMA buffers and devices are safe and isolated
Stop after any phase anomaly before continuing
Preserve logs; no automatic retry or blanket reboot
agent_execution_scope: Validate immutable phase manifest and each phase's gates
Collect phase-specific results/errors and state restoration
Report aggregate coverage without DUT verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: A generic NVQual command does not disclose or govern speed, DMA and power-state phases.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Invoke only a pinned decomposed suite with explicit per-phase targets, approvals and stop gates.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All named speed-change, DMA and GPU-power phases remain required; none is inferred complete from an aggregate exit code.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a phase matrix recording target, mutation, inputs, expected evidence, threshold, recovery and result for every suite component.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes composite coverage and blast radius auditable.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A total suite PASS cannot compensate for a skipped, unsupported or unsafe phase.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Vendor suite contents may change by version; DMA and power phases can corrupt data or strand devices.

project_override_considerations: Project authority decides required phase set and whether a safely omitted phase causes BLOCKED rather than PASS.
expected_evidence: DMA integrity/performance, speed/link and power-state recovery evidence
Per-phase cleanup/final health and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure describes a mutating composite qualification suite, while Criteria only test text readability and firmware and the source requests evidence-destroying log clearing.

blocked_analysis.analysis: A reviewed decomposable suite can be provisioned; an opaque or unsafe package is an execution-time block, not a reason to stop static review.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Compatibility row318 Wistron-NV GPU-00311-V003: approve pinned suite and complete phase manifest, safe topology/targets, DMA buffers, speed/power-state parameters, per-phase thresholds and recovery; define handling of unsafe/unsupported phases, preserve logs and map/replace unrelated Criteria.

review_improvement: Prevents an opaque aggregate result from hiding unexecuted speed, DMA or power-state coverage and forces recovery between hazardous phases.
independent_technical_reasoning: The named phases have different blast radii and evidence: DMA requires data-integrity controls, speed changes require link negotiation, and power transitions require wake and driver recovery. One command-level PASS cannot prove all three unless the exact versioned phase manifest and each phase result are retained.
